pages.title: The Fishing Village
paragraphs: Maria and Bartz step onto the dock of {island}. Lanterns burn in every window, yet the streets are empty, and the few locals they pass will not meet their eyes. A strange chill follows them from the harbor.

In the tavern they find a lone mage with a tome at his elbow: Cypher, who is here for reasons of his own. Maria asks after her husband, but the townsfolk are on edge. Shutters slam and doors are barred against the outsiders.
Then the bells ring, and the water boils with more Merfolk. Cypher rises and offers his fire. The village is under raid.

pages.title: Cypher Joins the Party
paragraphs: Cypher is a Mage who wields anima magic tomes. His Fire Tome is accurate and effective against beasts, while a Thunder Tome crits more often and is effective against aqua foes like the Merfolk.
Magic ignores a target's Defense and strikes against Resistance instead, but mages are frail. Keep him behind Bartz.

pages.title: Visiting Houses
paragraphs: The bright green tile marks a door you can visit. Move a unit onto it, choose Visit from the action menu, and the household will reward you with an item.
Each house can only be visited once, and a unit must be standing on its door tile. Reach them before the raiders do.
